description: This file defines the StatusMessages class, a Drupal render element used to display status, warning, and error messages, including methods for generating placeholders and rendering messages.

classes.name: StatusMessages
classes.description: A Drupal render element class for displaying status, warning, and error messages with placeholder generation and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns configuration info for the render element, including pre-render callback and display options.

methods.name: generatePlaceholder
methods.description: Generates a placeholder for messages, creating a render placeholder and optionally including fallback markup.

methods.name: renderMessages
methods.description: Replaces the placeholder with actual messages, optionally filtered by message type.
